mechanism.claim: A completed daily BTC return that is an extreme robust outlier relative to the median and median absolute deviation of the thirty strictly prior daily returns represents a transient low-frequency displacement. In elevated twenty-day variation, fade the outlier for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: opposite strict sign of current daily return minus the prior-thirty-day median
mechanism.why_distinct: VWAP candidates use traded-price centers inside intraday blocks; self-normalized displacement uses one block's L2 path; skew candidates use third moments. HVRDOR compares one completed daily return with a strictly prior robust return distribution using median/MAD, with no price-level anchor, volume, flow, fitted return, prior event, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed twenty-day daily realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one 02:05 UTC robust daily-outlier reversal clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every calendar day at exact 02:00 UTC
features.current_return: completed close-to-close BTC log return over [D-24h,D)
features.reference_returns: thirty exact coherent daily close-to-close returns ending strictly before current_return
features.reference_median: median of the thirty prior returns
features.reference_mad: median absolute deviation from reference_median, finite strict positive
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared current and prior nineteen daily returns), finite strict positive
features.prior_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 180 earlier source-valid daily decisions, minimum 120, current excluded

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: paper-supported low-frequency mean reversion with fixed prior-only median/MAD score

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no return window, robust estimator, MAD scale, rank history, outlier strength, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.paper: TESTING FOR TRADABLE ALPHA IN SHORT-TERM BITCOIN MARKET DATA
external_basis.author: Oliver Rustin
external_basis.reported_relation: a low-frequency mean-reversion strategy was modestly and consistently profitable after short-horizon features failed costs
external_basis.selection_use: low-frequency mean-reversion mechanism only; fixed robust estimator chosen before incidence
